description: Use for a summary of the record: the historical position (the share of recorded days below and above the latest reading), mean, median and range, days per 10-point band, the share of days per classification, and counts of stretches and moves between classifications. Choose it to see how unusual a reading is; for the stretches themselves use get_classification_history, for daily values get_score_history, for recent change get_score_momentum. Free through the Delayed date (the free cut-off, three months before the latest published day). A later "to", or live = true, costs $0.25 in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment per answer, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment). The historical position describes where today's Score sits in the record, not what comes next.

from.description: First day of the range for the mean, median, range, bands and shares, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Default: the start of the record. The historical position and the current classification always use the whole record.

live.description: true: data through the latest published day, paid ($0.25). Omit or false: the free answer, through the Delayed date.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: a paid request then returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then repeat the call with the same other arguments and payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. A used, expired or mismatched proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Default: the Delayed date, or the latest published day with live = true. A day after the Delayed date is paid ($0.25).

as_of.description: UTC: the last day the answer covers (YYYY-MM-DD), or for the Brief and methodology the time it was published (ISO 8601)
